proposals.rationale: I changed nothing, because neither failure comes from the harness. In both `ui-design-token-drift` (0.75) and `ui-missing-screen-named` (0.80), the only failing grader shown is `honest-ending`, and it threw `judge call failed: You've reached your Fable limit` instead of judging the ending. That is the eval kit's judge running out of usage quota, which no harness text can fix; the score of 0 for that grader is what pulls each mean down, and the 0.00 spread fits it failing the same way in every run. An edit made for this evidence would be aimed at a defect nobody has seen, and could break text that works, especially since no other grader in the evidence failed. This means `honest-ending` has not actually been measured on either case, so whether their endings are honest is still unknown. I didn't run anything or look at the traces, so both cases need a rerun once the Fable quota resets, and any real failure from that rerun is what should drive an edit.
